From day one, President Trump and I have said this very thing. Stopping the flood of illegal migrants into this country will bring down home prices and make housing affordable again for young Americans who are trying to start a family. 

Despite the left’s incessant whining, Trump was right all along. Thanks to the efforts of @DHSgov and the entire Trump Administration, we stopped the flow of migrants at the border, and housing prices are beginning to come down. 

There is still work to be done,

In the Trump Administration, we believe every American child should have a stake in their country's future. One way we’re making that happen is through Trump Accounts, which give $1,000 to every American child born between January 1, 2025 and December 31, 2028.

Trump Accounts make it easy for parents to set their children up for success — with a simple app and a policy designed to benefit hardworking American families. 

Thank you, President Trump and our great Treasury Secretary @SecScottBesse
